title: Bulk overwrite advances a repositioned output stream
summary: A three-byte overwrite now advanced the cursor to position three. The next single-byte write left the same five logical bytes as four individual writes.

change.description: The byte-array write now moves the position by the number of bytes copied even when the write fits entirely within the existing output.

notes: Splitting the same bytes across calls should leave their destination and the following write position unchanged.
